description: Source code for challenge building functions in a FreeCodeCamp project, including challenge type mappings, build functions for different challenge types, and utilities for processing challenge files.

classes.name: Source
classes.description: Represents the source code components for a challenge, including index, contents, and editableContents.

classes.name: BuildChallengeData
classes.description: Data structure containing challenge type, challenge files, required resources, template, and URL.

classes.name: BuildOptions
classes.description: Options for building challenges, such as preview mode and test runner usage.

classes.name: BuildResult
classes.description: Result of building a challenge, including challenge type, build output, sources, and errors.

methods.name: buildSourceMap
methods.description: Creates a source map from challenge files, concatenating source and editable contents.

methods.name: buildDOMChallenge
methods.description: Builds a DOM-based challenge, processing challenge files with transformers and embedding files into HTML.

methods.name: buildJSChallenge
methods.description: Builds a JavaScript challenge by applying transformers and concatenating challenge file contents.

methods.name: buildBackendChallenge
methods.description: Builds a backend challenge, primarily returning the URL as source.

methods.name: buildPythonChallenge
methods.description: Builds a Python challenge, applying Python transformers and generating source map.

methods.name: canBuildChallenge
methods.description: Checks if a challenge of a given type can be built based on available build functions.

methods.name: buildChallenge
methods.description: Dispatches challenge building based on challenge type, calling the appropriate build function.
